The Main Residence
Vaulted Cedar · Brick · Light

An open great room that lives like a lodge and entertains like a resort

At the heart of the home, kitchen, living, and dining share one soaring space beneath vaulted tongue-and-groove cedar ceilings. An oversized brick fireplace with a real wood-burning insert anchors the room, a loft gallery overlooks it all, and walls of glass pull the Okanagan light — and the vineyard outlook — inside. The main living area offers four bedrooms plus a den and three full bathrooms, including two main-floor bedrooms with pool views, one with its own full ensuite.

Renovated kitchen · stainless appliances · quartz-style counters · breakfast bar

The Primary Retreat

Pool views, a walk-in closet, and a spa-calibre ensuite

The primary suite overlooks the pool and pairs a large walk-in closet with a fully updated ensuite — frameless glass shower, double vanity, and backlit mirror detail.

Outdoor Living

A covered veranda, an outdoor pool, and a road that ends here

Set on 0.34 acres along a quiet no-through road shared by just three properties, the home opens to a full-length covered veranda strung with lights and framed in greenery — dining, lounging, and grilling zones overlooking the pool, with mountain and vineyard views beyond.

The Income Advantage

Two self-contained suites, $3,500+ per month

Downstairs, a legal two-bedroom suite and a separate one-bedroom in-law suite — each fully self-contained — currently generate more than $3,500 per month, a serious mortgage helper or multi-generational solution.

Legal 2-bed suite · 1-bed in-law suite · separate entrances
